title: 6-Pak
platform: genesis (Mega Drive, cartridge image in zip)

layout.offset_base: absolute cart offsets; each game is a complete 512KB Mega Drive ROM image at k*0x80000
layout.byte_order: big-endian 68000 (Mega Drive); 'SEGA' ASCII at bank+0x100 in native order (no byteswap)
layout.notes: Bank checksum words retain stock values (e.g. Sonic bank header cksum 0x264A = stock Sonic 1 REV00) but full-bank word sums differ => Sega applied bank-switch/menu patches inside the game banks. Columns bank at 0x80000 is headerless (no SEGA magic); identified by strings ('FLASH COLUMNS', 'SCORE JEWELS LEVEL').

counted_assets_vs_guesses.counted: 6 banks x 512KB verified from bytes; 7 Nemesis art streams in the Sonic bank byte-verified against documented clean Sonic 1 REV00 offsets (Sonic Retro SCHG)

native_target_asset.format: Nemesis-compressed 4bpp Mega Drive pattern art (525 tiles per Sonic Retro SCHG)
native_target_asset.role: Sonic character sprites (title-screen intro Sonic) - candidate for donor swap in writer stage
native_target_asset.verified_bytes: 82 0d 80 04 04 14 05 24 (Nemesis stream signature 0x80/0x82 start + 0x8004 code table marker)

assimilation_fingerprint.summary: [disc] engine guesses CRI 0.41 / Ninja 0.36 (both wrong for a Genesis cart; it is first-party Sega 68000 code). 'PLAY container (JGR)' claim is a misidentification. Nearest title JGR 0.118 - not usable as reader.
assimilation_fingerprint.correction: Platform confirmed genesis/.md from actual bytes; treat fingerprint engine claims as unverified
